instance.basis: V1.6.1 FIXTURE. The Oldsmar pattern end-to-end: a critical-band observation whose hostile attribution was later contested and reassessed benign. The record keeps its unlowered conditioned_priority (the raise was right given what was held), carries 'contested' in the evidence tier, and exits by disposition 'closed_benign' — the outcome the demotion doctrine prescribes, now representable in the schema.
